# Redlix Studio

Redlix Studio is a premier independent freelance development studio specializing in elite IT services, custom enterprise software engineering, and high-performance digital solutions based in Hyderabad, India.

## Core Services & Capabilities
- **Full-Stack Software Engineering**: Expertise in Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, PostgreSQL, and AWS.
- **Enterprise Solutions**: High-availability cloud scaling architectures, robust custom API engines, and secure database systems.
- **Dedicated Dev Partner Plan**: Ongoing monthly engineering subscriptions offering daily updates, slack syncs, and 7-day risk-free trials.
- **Custom Milestone Product Builds**: MVP prototyping, single-deliverable sprints, and post-launch maintenance.

## Shipped Portfolio Case Studies
- **Dhasha Media**: Scaled media distribution system with highly-optimized video-streaming APIs.
- **HSGA Telangana**: Centralized academic union registry and automated membership reporting portals.
- **SmartFit**: Digital gym SaaS facilitating automated schedules, payments, and client profiles.
- **HUS System**: Integrated private hospital management software resolving secure health workflows.
- **NSS CMRIT**: Collegiate volunteer orchestrator enabling real-time community impact tracking.
- **National Ecommerce**: Advanced B2C multi-vendor digital storefronts with rapid checkout systems.
